annotations.title: Queue the removal requests the person already approved

description: Requires OAuth and the 'submit_requests' permission. Without confirm: true it previews eligible listings (status preview). With confirm: true it queues removal requests for exactly those listings using an existing website approval and paid entitlement. It cannot approve listings, pick new sites or buy anything; unmet requirements return approval_required or entitlement_required. A request is not a removal.

confirm.description: true only after the person has seen the preview and said yes.
